title: Course
description: Educational course or class offering with instructor, curriculum, enrollment, pricing, and certification information. Used for online learning platforms, universities, and training programs.

title.description: Course title or name (e.g., Introduction to Web Development, Data Science Fundamentals)

description.description: Detailed description of the course content, learning objectives, and what students will learn

instructor.description: Full name of the course instructor or teacher

category.description: Course category or subject area (e.g., Programming, Business, Design, Science)

level.description: Difficulty level or target audience (e.g., beginner, intermediate, advanced, all-levels)

lessons.description: Number of lessons or modules in the course

enrolled.description: Total number of students currently enrolled in the course

rating.description: Average student rating, typically on a scale of 1-5

currency.description: ISO currency code for the course price (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP)

language.description: Language code of the course content (e.g., en, es, fr)

certificate.description: Whether the course offers a certificate upon completion

thumbnail.description: URL to the course thumbnail or cover image

created_at.description: Timestamp when the course was created
